messages:
alex.g: quick preflight — who's the confirmed owner for KMS evidence for the upcoming audit lane? need final owner + any blockers by EOD Fri. @security-bot can you tag last owner?
security-bot: reminder: SOC2 window opens 2026-04-12. Please set evidence owners in the tracker: https://go/secure-tracker :bell:
maya: i'll own the key rotation evidence (kms/rotations). will upload runbook + logs. blocking: need staging key export from eng-infra.
tj: noted. eng-infra can grant access, but need ticket in #eng-infra with env + expiry. @sam can you open? also there's a small script to pull metrics:
```bash
python tools/audit_pull.py --env staging --since 7d --output /tmp/rotation_logs.tar.gz
```
sam: opening ticket now. ticket: ENGINF-4821. ETA for access: Tue morning. @maya can you confirm the exact key alias?
maya: alias is arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/ab12-cdef
leah: I'll pick up auditlog ingestion ownership. need one question: does the auditflow include KMS key IDs in events? @tj
tj: yes – we emit key_id in auditflow v2. confirm there's an ingest filter to mask full ARNs, we only store truncated ids.
alex.g: perfect. can we add a migration task to the SOC2 board for the masking check? assign to leah + eng-sre.
leah: added task, card #SOC2-212. left a checklist: verify masking, retention policy, indexing for search.
sam: quick heads-up — staging export will be done in 2 hops. i'll share commands in the ticket. :thumbsup:
maya: tagging @oncall-rotation — please standby during export window (Tue 09:00-10:00 PT).
oncall-rotation: acknowledged. will monitor metrics during window. ping if any errors.
alex.g: last ask — anyone blocking on HSM attestation paperwork? if so, who can pair to close?
tj: HSM paperwork in progress, sam and i have a draft. need legal signoff — @leah can you escalate to compliance counsel?
leah: will loop in counsel today. note: counsel asked for a one-page summary of key usage patterns.
alex.g: ok. maya, please add that summary to the ticket. i'll book a 15-min sync if needed.
maya: added summary to ENGINF-4821 and SOC2-212. thanks. :wave:
security-bot: action items recap: owners: rotation=maya, ingestion=leah. tickets: ENGINF-4821, SOC2-212. next check-in Thu 10:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
